525 template <class C> bool autoconfig_wsc_authentication(WSC::m1 &m1, C &wsc, uint8_t authkey[32])
526 {
527 // Authentication on Full M1 || M2*/M8* (without the authenticator attribute)
528 // This is the content of M1 and M2/M8, without the type and length.
529 // Authentication is done on swapped data.
530 // Since m1 is parsed, it is in host byte order, and needs to be swapped.
531 // m2/m8 is created, and already finalized so its in network byte order, so no
532 // need to swap it.
533 m1.swap();
534 uint8_t buf[m1.getMessageLength() + wsc->getMessageLength() -
535 WSC::cWscAttrAuthenticator::get_initial_size()];
536 auto next = std::copy_n(m1.getMessageBuff(), m1.getMessageLength(), buf);
537 std::copy_n(wsc->getMessageBuff(),
538 wsc->getMessageLength() - WSC::cWscAttrAuthenticator::get_initial_size(), next);
539 // swap back
540 m1.swap();
541 uint8_t *kwa = reinterpret_cast<uint8_t *>(wsc->authenticator());
542 // Add KWA which is the 1st 64 bits of HMAC of config_data using AuthKey
543 if (!mapf::encryption::kwa_compute(authkey, buf, sizeof(buf), kwa)) {
544 LOG(ERROR) << "kwa_compute failure";
545 return false;
546 }
547 return true;
548 }

761 template <class Task>
762 void task_status_helper(bool task_enabled, int &current_task_id, const std::string &task_name)
763 {
764
765 int current_status = ((current_task_id > 0) * 2) + (task_enabled * 1);
766 // (current_task_id > 0) : is the task running ?
767 // task_enabled : should it be running ?
768
769 // using a switch case instead of a if/else construction
770 // as it arranges the four possible cases linearly, and should be more readable
771
772 switch (current_status) {
773 case 0: // task disabled and not running: do nothing
774 LOG(DEBUG) << task_name << ": already disabled";
775 break;
776 case 1: // task enabled but not running: start task
777 {
778 auto new_task = std::make_shared<Task>(database, cmdu_tx, m_task_pool);
779 LOG(DEBUG) << task_name << ": starting with task_id " << new_task->id;
780 current_task_id = new_task->id;
781 LOG_IF(!m_task_pool.add_task(new_task), FATAL) << "Failed adding task!" << task_name;
782 break;
783 }
784 case 2: // task disabled but running : kill task
785 {
786 LOG(DEBUG) << task_name << ": running with " << current_task_id << ", disabling";
787 m_task_pool.kill_task(current_task_id);
788 current_task_id = -1;
789 break;
790 }
791 case 3: // task enabled and running : do nothing
792 {
793 if (m_task_pool.is_task_running(current_task_id)) {
794 LOG(DEBUG) << task_name << " already running with task_id " << current_task_id;
795 } else {
796 LOG(ERROR) << task_name << " should be running but is not";
797 }
798 break;
799 }
800 }
801 }
